details: Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Putin met in Beijing, where they collectively denounced what they termed "irresponsible" U.S. foreign policy. This summit underscores strengthening ties between the two nations amidst global tensions, further solidifying an anti-U.S. partnership. While Russia's economy faces strain and its forces struggle in Ukraine, Putin described relations with China as "unprecedented and equal," despite an underlying imbalance.
title: Xi and Putin Condemn US Policy at Beijing Summit

details: The European Commission has initiated a public consultation to gather feedback on the functioning of the EU's Markets in Crypto Assets Regulation (MiCA). Implemented in 2024, MiCA established a harmonized framework for crypto-assets and related services. This move indicates ongoing efforts to adapt the regulatory landscape to the evolving digital asset markets.
title: EU Launches Consultation on MiCA Crypto Regulation

details: South Carolina has become a leading pro-Bitcoin state after Governor Henry McMaster signed Senate Bill S. 163 into law on May 19, 2026. This legislation includes a total ban on Central Bank Digital Currencies (CBDCs), establishes tax neutrality for crypto payments, and provides strong protections for miners and self-custody holders. The bipartisan support for the bill underscores a significant push for regulatory clarity and adoption within the state.
title: South Carolina Enacts Pro-Bitcoin Legislation

details: Global risk assets, including stock markets, surged on May 20, 2026, following statements from President Trump indicating that the United States and Iran are nearing the conclusion of intense diplomatic talks. This potential breakthrough eased concerns about an immediate conflict and energy supply disruptions, leading to a quick fall in WTI Crude oil prices. While Middle East tensions remain, the prospect of de-escalation boosted investor confidence across markets.
title: US-Iran Deal Hopes Boost Markets, Oil Prices Ease
